_edit_me: Editable source for the synthetic customer S1 (s1-mach). The organisation and roster live in the customer file named by `customer` (generated there by gen-customer.mjs); this config only holds scenario knobs. Then: node scripts/build-customer-scenario.mjs s1-mach (regenerates scenarios/s1-mach.json). tests/integration/customer-scenarios.test.ts fails if the generated scenario drifts from this config + the customer file.
description: synthetic-customer S1 (FICTIONAL): a 45-person CNC machining subcontractor on GCC High G5, cloud-only. 53 accounts (45 staff, 4 separate admin, 2 break-glass, 2 service), 14 groups incl. the 18-member CUI enclave, 58 Intune devices (50 compliant), 9 enforced CA policies excluding break-glass, 3 DLP policies, the CUI label, an Azure Government landing zone, and a 90-day history (sign-ins, audits, alerts, incidents, risk, PIM, Secure Score 61 -> 72 %, 34 CVEs with 28 remediated). Built through the real resolver path; history dated from the day-floored anchor.
